==Description==
The '''Sock Puppet''' was an enemy that appeared in the third act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health, high defense and was quite fast, making it quite dangerous.

==Appearance==
The '''Sock Puppet''' was a large sock puppet that was mounted on six mechanical legs. The sock puppet itself was an orange sock with black stripes, eyes and a mouth with white teeth and a tongue dangling out of it. Upon death, it made a hissing noise, thus the sock resembled a snake.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] are recommended.
**Multiple cheaper but weaker towers, like the [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can also be effective against this.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers.
*As this enemy is not immune to anything, slowing towers like the [[Warden]] or [[Sledger]] can be very useful against this, giving your towers more time to kill it.
**This is more apparent as this enemy is able to walk quite fast compared to most other enemies in this event.
**If necessary, the [[Spotlight]]s can also be used to confuse the '''Sock Puppet'''.
